entities.summary: The Church on Blood in Honour of All Saints Resplendent in the Russian Land is a Russian Orthodox church in Yekaterinburg. Being built on the site of the Ipatiev House where Nicholas II, the last Emperor of Russia, and his family, along with members of the household, were murdered by the Bolsheviks during the Russian Civil War, the church commemorates the Romanov sainthood. Church of All Saints is a church building in Europe, established in 2003. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
